title: Buffer Overflow Risk in Curl_inet_ntop and inet_ntop4
classified_slop_by: Daniel Stenberg gist 07f7581f6e3d78ef37dfbfc81fd1d1cd (AI slop security reports submitted to curl)
why_rejected: Closed on HackerOne as not-applicable and listed as AI slop in Stenberg's gist. The PoC overflows a hand-written copy of inet_ntop4 with a deliberately undersized 10-byte buffer; curl's real callers always pass adequately sized buffers, so no overflow is reachable in curl. The public disclosure JSON exposes no maintainer comment text.
attachments_note: The HackerOne report listed two text attachments (F3824033 curl-inet.c, F3824034 curl-inet-test.txt). Their standalone contents were not retrieved; the equivalent C snippets are reproduced inline in report.md as the reporter included them in the body.
